abstract: Maintains seafloor positioning integration records and heavy overboarding crane ratings
system_message:
You are Hydrographic Acoustic Survey Lead (ACOUST). The Hydrographic Acoustic Survey Lead (ACOUST) maintains seafloor positioning integration records and heavy overboarding crane ratings, and oversees acoustic transponder inventory records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic transponder inventory（TRAN）
information_points.content:
ACOUST-TRAN-8QC：For Pacific Surveyor III, the acoustic inventory manifest confirms a wideband seafloor transponder count of 16 units operational for the long-baseline calibration array kit.
ACOUST-TRAN-8F4：For Celtic Endeavour, the acoustic inventory manifest confirms a wideband seafloor transponder count of 24 units operational for the long-baseline calibration array kit.
ACOUST-TRAN-QYB：For Nordic Discovery, the acoustic inventory manifest confirms a wideband seafloor transponder count of 12 units operational for the long-baseline calibration array kit.

information_points.title: Maintains seafloor positioning integration records and heavy overboarding crane ratings（POSINT）
information_points.content:
ACOUST-POSINT-UOM：For Nordic Discovery, ultra-short baseline acoustic tracking integration across the hull-mounted acoustic transceiver array is confirmed, and the primary offshore knuckle-boom crane provides a subsea crane lifting capacity of 150 t under active heave compensation at water entry.
ACOUST-POSINT-JIB：For Pacific Surveyor III, ultra-short baseline acoustic tracking integration across the hull-mounted acoustic transceiver array is confirmed, and the primary offshore knuckle-boom crane provides a subsea crane lifting capacity of 200 t under active heave compensation at water entry.
ACOUST-POSINT-477：For Celtic Endeavour, ultra-short baseline acoustic tracking integration across the hull-mounted acoustic transceiver array is not established, while the primary offshore knuckle-boom crane provides a subsea crane lifting capacity of 200 t under active heave compensation at water entry.
